node.statement: By definition tilde-Upsilon=v^(-1) tilde-Phi, hence tilde-Upsilon_n=v_n^(-1) tilde-Phi_n. Combining the uniform inverse bound with ||tilde-Phi_n||<=1+C_theta*eta and submultiplicativity yields ||tilde-Upsilon_n||<=(1+C_theta*eta)/(1-C_V*eta) for every n; taking the supremum over n gives the claimed cb bound.
